question: do the choices P6 offers on classic.m3 / m7 / m8 under v21.b1 still meet the replication rule, on both sides, on the frozen semantics?

seeds.rule: disjoint from the P6 blocks 65001-65100 and 65501-65900

design: balanceTool.v21 (template table v21.b1). For each side: the template plus that one choice on that side, std on the other, paired by seed against the template without the choice on that side. Same instrument as P6 stage 2 (runTruthMatch, items standard, skills on)

plan.rule: every row of the two P6 result files with stage-1 pass or stage-2 confirmed; the tool refuses if this list differs from what those files derive
plan.controls: one per side and template (classic.m3, classic.m7, classic.m8)
plan.expectedEffort: about 3.6 h single line at the 1.05 s/match measured in P6

decisionRule.confirmed: on BOTH sides n >= 200 valid pairs, z >= 3 and relative effect >= 0.05 in the claimed direction
decisionRule.source: the replication rule of tactic_followup_3a_replication.json, the same as P6 stage 2
decisionRule.notReplicated: a side with n >= 200 valid pairs misses the rule

overall.PASS: every item confirmed, no errored match
overall.FAILED: any item not_replicated: a failed check of the formal acceptance (stopRules.anyOtherRed), reported to the Owner; rows are not edited to make it pass
overall.INCONCLUSIVE: any item with fewer than 200 valid pairs on a side and none not_replicated, or any errored match up to 1% of the planned matches, which gives no verdict on any item: the Owner decides

decisionRule.minValidPairsAuthority: Owner Review 2026-11-02 decision 3; lowering it after the fact is forbidden
decisionRule.achievability: checked before registering, from the P6 raw records, no reserved seed: all 13 metrics are valid in 100 of 100 matches on the blue side and in 100 of 100 on the red side of the same matches (a proxy: stage 1 ran blue arms only); the two stage-2 items measured 400 of 400 on both sides. Expected about 400 per side, far above the floor
decisionRule.order: not_replicated when a side with n >= 200 misses the rule; otherwise inconclusive when a side has n < 200; otherwise confirmed
decisionRule.inconclusive: no side misses the rule and a side has n < 200 valid pairs
decisionRule.mixedCase: a side with n >= 200 that misses the rule makes the item not_replicated and the study FAILED, even when the other side has n < 200; that other side is recorded in insufficientSides (Owner approval 2026-11-02)

noRetries: no re-run, no seed swap, no metric swap, no seed dropped by hand
notClaimed: behaviour only. No win-rate claim for a table template combined with a choice: that is a known verification gap and not a pass (stage1_formal_acceptance_registration_3aB.json knownVerificationGaps)

review.verdict: APPROVE WITH CHANGES (independent review of the frozen fingerprint, seeds, tools and criteria at 596113c1: 0 Blockers, 0 Majors; the procedural changes applied before the first match)

requiresResult.why: stopRules.ga8: the confirmatory G-A8 runs FIRST and a STOP halts every other formal measurement; INCONCLUSIVE goes to the Owner. Enforced by the tool, not by procedure
